interface.shortDescription: Security scanning for the code Codex writes
interface.longDescription: Gadriel is an AI Security Harness for Codex. Every file Codex writes is scanned the moment it is written, and a serious finding is handed straight back with the fix so it is corrected before the turn moves on. Around that guardrail, Codex gets Gadriel's security MCP tools and 17 skills covering SAST, secrets, dependencies, containers and configuration, including AI-specific risks such as prompt injection and the OWASP LLM Top 10. Scanning runs on your machine.
defaultPrompt: Run a Gadriel security scan on this repository.
Fix the Gadriel findings in this file.
Scan this change for OWASP LLM Top 10 risks.
